title.zh: 合作社（第 97 条下的豁免）命令 2015
title.vi: Lệnh Hợp tác xã (Miễn trừ theo Điều 97) 2015
title.th: คำสั่งสหกรณ์ (การยกเว้นตามมาตรา 97) 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co‑operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) Order 2015 and comes into operation on 16 November 2015.

2. ExxonMobil Employees’ Co‑operative Limited is exempt from section 89(3) of the Act, insofar as —
(a)any moneys remaining after the application of its funds to the purposes specified in section 88 of the Act; and
(b)any sums unclaimed after 2 years from the date of cancellation of its registration,
are to be donated to the Children’s Cancer Foundation, instead of being transferred to the Co‑operative Societies Liquidation Account.
